UpdateSourceArgs:
-c "\
            echo '[Thunderstore CLI] Starting CLI download process...'; \
            mkdir -p \"{{$FullInstanceDir}}Valheim/thunderstore-cli\" || { echo '[Thunderstore CLI] ERROR: Failed to create CLI directory.'; exit 1; }; \
            wget -q \"https://github.com/thunderstore-io/thunderstore-cli/releases/download/{{CLI_VERSION}}/tcli-{{CLI_VERSION}}-linux-x64.tar.gz\" -O \"{{$FullInstanceDir}}thunderstore-cli.tar.gz\"; \
            if [ ! -s \"{{$FullInstanceDir}}thunderstore-cli.tar.gz\" ]; then \
                echo '[Thunderstore CLI] ERROR: Downloaded file is empty or failed to download.'; \
                rm -f \"{{$FullInstanceDir}}thunderstore-cli.tar.gz\"; \
                exit 1; \
            else \
                echo '[Thunderstore CLI] CLI downloaded successfully.'; \
            fi; \
            tar -xzf \"{{$FullInstanceDir}}thunderstore-cli.tar.gz\" -C \"{{$FullInstanceDir}}Valheim/thunderstore-cli\" --strip-components=1 || { echo '[Thunderstore CLI] ERROR: Failed to extract CLI archive.'; rm -f \"{{$FullInstanceDir}}thunderstore-cli.tar.gz\"; exit 1; }; \
            rm -f \"{{$FullInstanceDir}}thunderstore-cli.tar.gz\"; \
            chmod +x \"{{$FullInstanceDir}}Valheim/thunderstore-cli/tcli\" \"{{$FullInstanceDir}}Valheim/thunderstore-cli/tcli-bepinex-installer\" || { echo '[Thunderstore CLI] ERROR: Failed to set CLI executable permissions.'; exit 1; }; \
            echo '[Thunderstore CLI] Thunderstore CLI installation completed successfully.'"
